operatorNotes: Initial typecheck found an incorrect Row property and nullable indexed access; corrected before successful checks.
Initial requested preview AndroidTest wrapper task was unsupported; used the existing debug test task targeting the same debug package. No wrapper/dependency changes.
Initial UI locator runs were stopped/corrected after slow scrolling or scrolling past asynchronously loaded summary content. Final run waits for summary and checks observed outcomes.
Native aggregate/page checks use synthetic facts only in a separate encrypted store and remove its owned folder/key. Real history never receives fixture facts.

Final preservation check found an accessibility-master mismatch after install/instrumentation. Restored the exact original master value from the private baseline without changing selected services; final backup/accessibility comparison passes. Exact platform cause was not investigated.
limits: All-time app duration/open totals and whole-history app ranking are not implemented; app search and totals cover only the labelled date page.

SQL aggregates bound returned rows and avoid lifetime row materialization; query cost still scales with retained facts. Durable rollups, million-row latency and coordinator responsiveness need qualification.
Older/newer enabled UI actions and empty-history UI were not exercised against the real one-page history; native synthetic paging/empty checks are separate evidence.
Full chronology, coverage/provenance partitions, custom last-X days, TalkBack, large text, RTL, all-theme and injected error-state breadth remain open.
publicationScope: Reviewed regular commit/push to develop only; no main merge, workflow dispatch, release signing or binary publication.
